kurz: Icing sugar is nothing more than finely ground granulated sugar. A powerful blender does it in a minute.
bild_im_kopf: Like pebbles ground into sand: it is the same stone, but it behaves completely differently.
sicherheit: Fine sugar dust: only open the blender once it has settled.
haltbarkeit: Keeps a long time, airtight and dry. Sieve out lumps before use.
verwendung: Glazes and icing: it dissolves at once without crunching.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Grind the sugar finely in short bursts
schluesselmomente.warum: The crystals break into tiny splinters. The surface becomes a thousand times larger.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Wait two minutes before opening the lid

schluesselmomente.warum: Coarse leftovers would crunch in a glaze.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Mix in starch if you like
schluesselmomente.warum: Sugar dust attracts moisture and clumps. Starch keeps it free-flowing.
